title: Just ok
text:
Just ok. I bought this to replace one similar (same brand) that I had had maybe 12-15 years. I have all hard wood floors and multiple hairy pets so I need something for quick cleaning.
Pros: light, nice color options, suction seems good, price.
Cons: feels cheaply made, rattles like its cheaply made when pushing/pulling it, after 2nd use the handle part is lose and wiggles (maybe i can screw it tighter??), cord is stupidly short.
Overall: for the price it's good however I was very tempted to return it over how short the cord is. I have to plug it in 3 different places just to get my whole livingroom and it's not a big room.
